description: Keyword ideas for SEO and ads: the search phrases real users type for a seed keyword, from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon and DuckDuckGo autocomplete, deduplicated and ranked by how many engines suggest each, with question and buying-intent phrases listed apart. deep=true adds the Google long tail (seed + a-z, how, what, best, vs), up to 200 keywords. Use to plan content, find long-tail and question keywords, or name a product. No search volumes. Example: seed=crm software. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

country.description: Country code (default us); Amazon suggestions come from that country's store where one exists

deep.description: true to add the Google long tail (seed + each letter, question words); about 30 more lookups

engines.description: Optional comma list: google, bing, youtube, amazon, duckduckgo (default all)
